newsitem.title: USA: Japanese boy, 14, sails across Pacific solo.
newsitem.headline: Japanese boy, 14, sails across Pacific solo.

text.p: A 14-year-old Japanese boy arrived in San Francisco Bay on Friday after sailing single-handed across the Pacific Ocean, setting what is thought to be a record for the youngest person to make the voyage.
Subaru Takahashi sailed under the Golden Gate Bridge into San Francisco Bay some 53 days after setting out from Tokyo on July 22 in the 30-foot (nine-metre) yacht "Advantage" -- a borrowed boat.
No one had heard from him for almost the last month of the 5,000 mile (8,000 km) voyage because his radio ran out of power, cutting off his communications.

Takahashi, a high school student from Shirone in central Japan, looked healthy and none the worse for wear as he was greeted by his parents and well-wishers at the Corinthian Yacht Club in Tiburon, just across the bay from San Francisco.
"My dream is to travel around the world. This is my first step to accomplish that dream," a smiling Takahashi told reporters, speaking through an interpreter.

Peter Hogg, staff commodore at the Corinthian Yacht Club who was involved in the project, was full of praise for Takahashi, believed to be the youngest person to sail single- handed across the Pacific Ocean.
"I think this is an exceptional kid. He's only 14 years old, but a very mature 14 years," Hogg told Reuters.

Hogg voiced reservations about a boy with limited practical experience undertaking such an arduous voyage, but he said Takahashi was "a child prodigy" and predicted that people would hear a lot about him in future.

Hogg said Takahashi had a problem with an engine that drives a generator on board his boat on August 11 and five days later he ran out of power and was unable to use his radio or self-steering devices. But Takahashi was able to set up a system to let the boat steer itself.
Helpers on land did not become too concerned about Takahashi's radio silence, correctly assuming he had a power problem. The boat was stocked with food and water for 60 days.
Takahashi began canoeing at age five and took up sailing when he was 10. He plans to stay in the San Francisco area for a few days before flying home.
